mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies with a temperature of 74 degrees by Badger Ridge Middle School. Under the Waning Gibbous moon, we have a space station sighting starting at 4:17 AM, moving from the northwest over Middleton toward the east-northeast near Fitchburg and Madison.

The Verona Senior Center has announced that they are replacing flooring throughout the building starting September 1. This means wellness appointments and outdoor programs will be the primary services until regular programming resumes on September 11.

There is plenty to do with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia happening today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the downtown farmer's market, yoga at Insight Wellness, or even more trivia at The Bogey Factory.

Looking at the weekly report, on August 25, officers utilized an automated external defibrillator to assist a 68-year-old man who was not breathing, successfully helping him regain a pulse before EMS arrival.
You can enjoy today's flavor of the day, which is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store opens today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
